text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be big, like BOOM, KABLAM!
Also... I wanna do something
that feels
fast!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
...Um, we're talking about our plan for the
special concert, right?
Gotta admit, I'm
not getting a concert feel from what you
just said.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
By "boom" and "kablam," I presume she's
looking for something with
impact. As for
"fast," well...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
We could prepare a float decorated with
lights for a few participants
to pull and run
with.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a good idea. I so love your
think-first-act-later attitude,
Ikuno!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha, they seem to be having a lot of fun
over there. Well, we'll do
our best to come
up with a plan too!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know if I have as free an
imagination as the older students,
but I'll
try!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
We'll do our best to make this important
commemorative concert a
success!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I like that enthusiasm! Let's start by
talking about what color
shutter shades we
want to wear!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
